Name: No Pendant
Description: No pendant equipped.

Name: No Ring
Description: No ring equipped.

Name: Antidote Pendant
Description: Protects the wearer against the effects of poison.

Name: Calming Pendant
Description: Protects the wearer against the effects of berserk.

Name: Dharma Pendant
Description: No need to fear the reaper while wearing this amulet, giving the wearer immunity against instant death.

Name: Diamond Locket
Description: A diamond necklace that massively improves the wearer's magic damage.

Name: Draconite Pendant
Description: A pendant cut from Kaelenon's Draconite. It strengthens the Recover Jump modification, restoring more health and mana when the wearer lands.

Name: Earth Amulet
Description: An amulet with a dense green gem veined like ancient bedrock.

Name: Earth Chain
Description: A necklace carved from polished stone, heavy with the patience of deep caverns.

Name: Electric Amulet
Description: An amulet with a storm-bright gem that clicks with tiny sparks.

Name: Electric Chain
Description: A necklace strung with storm glass that hums softly before lightning strikes.

Name: Element Amulet
Description: Base class for the various element amulets, each shaped around a concentrated warding jewel.

Name: Element Chain
Description: Base class for the various element chains, each forged around a focused elemental core.

Name: Elemental Amulet
Description: Legend claims the jewel of this amulet is actually the heart of a god, still turning with every color of creation.

Name: Elemental Chain
Description: Fashioned from the cores of elementals, this necklace shifts color as nearby magic changes shape.

Name: Fire Amulet
Description: An amulet with a ruby heart that burns like a banked coal.

Name: Fire Chain
Description: A necklace set with a warm ember-stone that glows brighter near open flame.

Name: Garfunkel Pendant
Description: The Sound of Silence can be deafening but not with this necklace.

Name: Gold Necklace
Description: A gold-chained necklace that greatly improves the wearer's magic damage.

Name: Gorgon Pendant
Description: Made from the scale of a Gorgon, this ring protects the wearer against petrification.

Name: Ice Amulet
Description: An amulet with a frost-white gem that leaves a chill on the skin.

Name: Ice Chain
Description: A necklace of pale crystal links that stay cold even in midsummer heat.

Name: Invisibility Pendant
Description: Makes the wearer invisible and harder to hit.

Name: Levitation Pendant
Description: Gives the wearer the ability to fly, making them harder to hit and immune to ground-based spells. The downfall is that Wind spells will hurt more.

Name: Magic Pendant
Description: An amulet that makes the wearer harder to hit with magic spells.

Name: Pendant of Vision
Description: A pendant that that gives information about the enemy.

Name: Platinum Necklace
Description: A platinum-chained necklace that massively improves the wearer's magic damage.

Name: Ribbon Pendant
Description: Forged from a rare mineral, this pendant provides the wearer with immunity from all negative status effects.

Name: Ruby Locket
Description: A ruby necklace that improves the wearer's magic defense.

Name: Sapphire Locket
Description: A sapphire necklace that greatly improves the wearer's magic defense.

Name: Silver Necklace
Description: A silver-chained necklace that improves the wearer's magic damage.

Name: Water Amulet
Description: An amulet with a deep blue gem that seems to ripple beneath its surface.

Name: Water Chain
Description: A necklace of blue-green links that beads with dew in dry air.

Name: Wind Amulet
Description: An amulet with a clear gem that feels almost weightless in the hand.

Name: Wind Chain
Description: A necklace of feather-light silver links that stir when no breeze is present.

Name: Accuracy Ring
Description: A ring that improves the wearer's weapon accuracy by 10%.

Name: Barrier Ring
Description: A ring that increases the wearer's chance to block attacks by 25%, even without having a shield equipped.

Name: Class Ring
Description: A ring that changes depending on the wearer's specialty.

Name: Evasion Ring
Description: A ring that improves the wearer's chance to dodge.

Name: Force Ring
Description: A ring that massively improves the wearer's attack damage.

Name: Iron Ring
Description: A ring that improves the wearer's defense.

Name: Might Ring
Description: A ring that greatly improves the wearer's attack damage.

Name: Power Ring
Description: A ring that improves the wearer's attack damage.

Name: Steel Ring
Description: A ring that greatly improves the wearer's defense.

Name: Titanium Ring
Description: A ring that massively improves the wearer's defense.

Name: Cloak of Enchantment
Description: A magical cloak that shields the wearer from all forms of attack.

Name: Cloth Cloak
Description: An outdoor cloth garment, typically sleeveless, that hangs loosely from the shoulders.

Name: Gold Cloak
Description: A cloak weaved with strands of gold to improve protective power.

Name: Robes of Merlin
Description: The enchanted robes of Merlin the enchanter.

Name: Silver Cloak
Description: A cloak weaved with strands of silver to improve protective power.

Name: Tarnkappe
Description: A tarnkappe is a mythical garment that grants its wearer the power to become invisible and move undetected. The Tarnkappe is depicted as a dark, enchanted cloak or hood, embodying the idea of secrecy, stealth, and mysticism.

Name: Tunic
Description: A close-fitting short coat as part of a uniform, especially a police or military uniform.

Name: Wizard's Robe
Description: A knee-length, long-sleeved robe with an impressive hood designed to add a mysterious feel to magic users.

Name: Chain Mail
Description: Made of interlocking metal rings, includes a layer of quilted fabric worn underneath the mail to prevent chafing and to cushion the impact of blows. The suit includes gauntlets.

Name: Genji Armor
Description: Mythical armor crafted by an unknown master blacksmith and embued with protective enchantments that allow the user to shrug off damage.

Name: Maximilian
Description: Maximilian armor is characterized by its intricate designs and full-coverage plates. Known for its effectiveness in both defense and mobility, this armor often features a distinctive fluted design, which not only enhances its aesthetic appeal but also reinforces the structure, providing extra strength without adding excessive weight.

Name: Palangina
Description: A Persian lamellar cuirass worked with fire-red and water-blue inlays.

Name: Plate Mail
Description: Armor consisting of shaped, interlocking metal plates to cover most of the body.

Name: Ring Mail
Description: Leather armor with heavy rings sewn into it. The rings help reinforce the armor against blows from Swords and axes.

Name: Splint Mail
Description: Armor made of narrow vertical strips of metal riveted to a backing of leather that is worn over cloth padding. Flexible chain mail protects the joints.

Name: Cuirboulli
Description: French for "boiled leather", this armor has increased rigidity for add protection

Name: Dragon Hide
Description: Hide armor made from the scales of a red dragon, inconceivably light for this type of armor.

Name: Leather Armor
Description: A protective covering made of animal hide, boiled to make it tough and rigid and worn over the torso to protect it from injury.

Name: Mithril Coat
Description: A mithril coat is a lightweight, shimmering shirt of armor made from mithril, a rare and incredibly strong metal. Known for its silver-like appearance and superior durability, the mithril coat offers exceptional protection while remaining much lighter than traditional steel armor.

Name: Padded Armor
Description: Consists of quilted layers of cloth and feathers to provide some protection from attack.

Name: Studded Cuirboulli
Description: Boiled leather armor embedded with iron studs to improve defensive capabilities.

Name: Studded Leather
Description: Leather armor embedded with iron studs to improve defensive capabilities.

Name: Breastplate
Description: Armor consisting of a fitted metal chest piece worn with supple leather. Although it leaves the legs and arms relatively unprotected, this armor provides good protection for the wearer's vital organs while leaving the wearer relatively unencumbered.

Name: Chain Shirt
Description: A type of armor consisting of small metal rings linked together in a pattern to form a mesh.

Name: Half Plate
Description: Armor consisting of shaped metal plates that cover most of the wearer's body. It does not include leg Protection beyond simple greaves that are attached with leather straps.

Name: Hide Armor
Description: A crude armor made from thick furs and pelts.

Name: Klivanion
Description: A lamellar breastplate whose charged plates lash attackers with lightning and can stun them in place.

Name: Kusari
Description: Kusari armor is made from interconnected metal rings, providing excellent flexibility and mobility. This chain mail offers robust protection while allowing for ease of movement, making it ideal for both ranged and close combat.

Name: Scale Mail
Description: Armor consisting of a coat and leggings of leather covered with overlapping pieces of metal, mimicking the scales of a fish.

Name: No Armor
Description: No armor equipped.

Name: Ariadne's Diadem
Description: A legendary diadem whose threadlike filigree guides the wearer safely through impossible danger.

Name: Circlet
Description: A thin metal circlet that focuses the wearer's will into a protective halo.

Name: Cloth Cap
Description: A simple padded cap that offers modest protection without interfering with spellcasting.

Name: Cohuleen Druith
Description: A fey cap steeped in old river magic and woven with reeds from a hidden ford.

Name: Enchanted Hood
Description: A hood embroidered with protective thread that turns aside glancing blows.

Name: Jaapi
Description: A quilted cloth head wrap that cushions blows while staying light enough for spellwork.

Name: Mitre Hat
Description: A ceremonial mitre reinforced with sacred thread and geomantic sigils.

Name: Turban
Description: Layered cloth wound into a protective wrap that softens glancing strikes.

Name: Witch Hat
Description: A tall enchanted hat stiffened with hidden ribs and protective wards.

Name: Barbute
Description: A heavy helm with a T-shaped opening and strong cheek protection.

Name: Close Helm
Description: A fully enclosing heavy helm with a fitted visor and reinforced gorget.

Name: Great Helm
Description: A full steel helm with narrow eye slits and thick plates.

Name: Iron Helm
Description: A heavy iron helmet that favors protection over comfort.

Name: Kabuto
Description: A legendary heavy helm with layered plates and a commanding crest.

Name: Kettle Helm
Description: A brimmed iron helmet that sheds blows away from the face and neck.

Name: Plate Helm
Description: A masterwork plate helmet that completes a knight's heavy armor kit.

Name: Arming Cap
Description: A reinforced cap worn under heavier helms or alone by light fighters.

Name: Demon Cowl
Description: A sinister cowl threaded with funereal charms and ash-dark silk.

Name: Katapu
Description: A light protective headpiece built from layered plates and lacquered leather.

Name: Leather Cap
Description: A boiled leather cap that protects the head while keeping movement light.

Name: Pith Helmet
Description: A stiffened light helmet with a broad brim and padded crown.

Name: Sōmen
Description: A full-face light helm that protects without sacrificing agility.

Name: War Mask
Description: A hardened leather mask shaped to intimidate and deflect cuts.

Name: Cervelliere
Description: A close-fitting steel skullcap that can be worn beneath other headgear.

Name: Chain Coif
Description: A hood of interlocking metal rings worn under or instead of a helmet.

Name: Helm of Rostam
Description: A heroic medium helm whose crest steadies the wearer against panic and stunning blows.

Name: Kulah Khud
Description: A domed medium helm with cheek guards and a mail aventail.

Name: Scale Helm
Description: A sturdy helmet of overlapping metal scales.

Name: Tarnhelm
Description: A mythic helm that bends sight around its wearer and grants invisibility.

Name: Tolga
Description: A heavy medium helm with reinforced bands and a high nasal guard.

Name: Visored Sallet
Description: A fitted steel helmet with a narrow visor and strong neck guard.

Name: No Helmet
Description: No helmet equipped.

Name: Dragon's Tear
Description: A crystallized tear shed by a dragon. Said to contain the essence of draconic vitality and regeneration. Extremely rare.

Name: Throwing Daggers
Description: A pack used by Hidden Blade. Daggers remaining: 10.

Name: Armor Piercing Bolts
Description: Hardened bolts that ignore armor. Bolts remaining: 10.

Name: Delayed Bolts
Description: Bolts that explode one turn after attaching. Bolts remaining: 10.

Name: Heat-Seeking Bolts
Description: Bolts that curve toward warm targets. Bolts remaining: 10.

Name: Magic Bolts
Description: Arcane ammunition for a Magic Crossbow. Bolts remaining: 10.

Name: Metal Bolts
Description: Durable ammunition with a high recovery chance. Bolts remaining: 10.

Name: Napalm Bolts
Description: Explosive bolts that spread burning material. Bolts remaining: 10.

Name: Wooden Bolts
Description: Fragile wooden crossbow ammunition. Bolts remaining: 10.

Name: Cryptic Key
Description: A pristine key forged by Griswold. Its purpose is shrouded in mystery, but it feels important.

Name: Key
Description: Unlocks a locked chest but is consumed.

Name: Master Key
Description: Unlocks doors that may lead to either valuable treasure or to powerful enemies.

Name: Old Key
Description: Unlocks doors that may lead to either valuable treasure or to powerful enemies.

Name: Censer of Choking Ash
Description: A reusable censer that blankets the surrounding area in choking smoke. Required to cast Obscuration.

Name: Oculus
Description: An expensive arcane lens that reveals the telltale shimmer of fake walls.

Name: Bird Fat
Description: The fat from a bird, used as a fuel for lamps.

Name: Cursed Hops
Description: Hops from a cursed tree, these flower are used primarily in the creation of beer and other beverages, as well as herbal medicines.

Name: Dead Soldier
Description: The partially eaten body of a very green soldier. He never stood a chance...

Name: Elemental Mote
Description: The elemental core of a Myrmidon.

Name: Feather
Description: The feather of a bird.

Name: Jester Token
Description: A carnival token that shimmers with magical energy. These are required to breach the Jester's inner sanctum.

Name: Leather
Description: The dried skin of an animal, used for various purposes.

Name: Mystery Meat
Description: Unknown meat with a strange smell. Maybe you could do something with this.

Name: Phylactery
Description: The soul artifcat of a Lich, given up willingly to achieve immortality.

Name: Power Core
Description: The power source of a Golem.

Name: Rat Tail
Description: The tail of a rat.

Name: Scrap Metal
Description: A chunk of metal.

Name: Snake Skin
Description: The skin of a snake.

Name: Ticket Piece
Description: A scrap of a lottery ticket with a few numbers on it.

Name: Acorn
Description: A hardy oak seed prized by druids for growth rites.

Name: Fungus Spore
Description: A powdery spore bundle useful in poison and decay rites.

Name: Hemlock Root
Description: A bitter root gathered for dangerous druidic mixtures.

Name: Reality Fragment
Description: A splinter of impossible matter. Thaumaturgists consume it to force a Miracle past the ordinary laws of conjuration.

Name: Soul Gem
Description: A crystallized soul used to barter for stronger fiend-contract outcomes.

Name: Vine Seed
Description: A coiled seed that hums with grasping green life.

Name: Blank Scroll
Description: A prepared scroll with enough receptive ink to hold one stolen spell.

Name: Bless Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast Bless, which increases attack damage for several turns. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Boost Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the heal spell Boost. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Cleanse Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the holy spell Cleanse. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Death Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast Desoul, which can kill the target. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Dispel Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast Dispel, which can remove all positive status effects from the target. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Earth Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the earth spell Tremor. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Electric Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the electric spell Shock. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Fire Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the fire spell Firebolt. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Holy Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the holy spell Holy. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Ice Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the ice spell Ice Lance. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Photon Sphere Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the powerful Photon Sphere. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Sanctuary Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast Sanctuary, which can return the user to town. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Scroll
Description: Base class for scrolls.

Name: Shadow Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the shadow spell Shadow Bolt. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Sheet Music: Battle Hymn
Description: A martial hymn for battle.

Name: Sheet Music: Bones, Thugs, and Harmony
Description: A graveyard harmony.

Name: Sheet Music: Chorus Time
Description: A looping chorus.

Name: Sheet Music: Gold Trigger
Description: A glittering trigger phrase.

Name: Sheet Music: Low-defense-ian Rhapsody
Description: A tune that lowers defenses.

Name: Sheet Music: Ode to the Ramparts
Description: A protective ode.

Name: Sheet Music: Scores and Scores Score
Description: A score about scoring.

Name: Sheet Music: Slow Ride
Description: A dragging song.

Name: Sheet Music: Symphony of Disfunction
Description: A discordant enemy-breaking score.

Name: Shell Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the heal spell Shell. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Silence Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast Silence, which can prevent an target from casting spell for a time. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Sleep Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast Sleep. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Stolen Magic Missile Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with a stolen copy of Magic Missile. Charges: 5. The scroll crumbles when its charges run out.

Name: Water Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the water spell Water Jet. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Wind Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the wind spell Gust. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Brass Key
Description: A brass key, similar to the key for your storage locker in the barracks.

Name: Chalice Map
Description: A weathered map whose ink appears almost completely faded.

Name: Draconite
Description: A red-black shard from Kaelenon's home realm, warm with restored draconic power.

Name: Empty Vial
Description: An empty vial, perfect for storing liquids and other tinctures.

Name: Excaliper
Description: The broken fragments of a failed experiment. It appears someone tried to forge the legendary sword Excalibur using a caliper tool. It did not go well...

Name: Golden Chalice
Description: A golden chalice that once held the Holy Grail. It is said that the chalice can grant immense power to those who drink from it, but it is also cursed with a terrible thirst.

Name: Heartstone Shard
Description: A mineral fragment that beats once when held still.

Name: Hexagonum
Description: The Hexagonum relic represents the natural world, since the hexagon is the considered the strongest shape and regularly found in nature.

Name: Infinitas
Description: Shaped like a circle, the Infinitas relic represents the never-ending struggle between good and evil.

Name: Joffrey's Letter
Description: A letter written from Joffrey to the waitress; maybe there is some use of this.

Name: Joker
Description: They say that Joker's are wild; you'll see how wild this one is.

Name: Kaelenon's Portal Key
Description: A glass-dark key printed from the Realm of Cambion terminal for Kaelenon's return home.

Name: Lucky Locket
Description: A simple gold necklace with a locket containing the picture of a fair lass.

Name: Luna
Description: The Moon, our celestial partner, is the inspiration for the Luna relic and represents love for others.

Name: Polaris
Description: The Polaris relic resembles the shape of a star and represents the guiding light of the North Star.

Name: Quadrata
Description: The Quadrata relic symbolizes order, trust, stability, and logic, the hallmarks of a well-balanced person.

Name: Serpent Venom Heart
Description: A pulsing knot of venom that refuses to die.

Name: Spring Water
Description: A vial of the finest spring water.

Name: Stormglass Feather
Description: A translucent feather with lightning trapped along its spine.

Name: Thieves Guild Signet
Description: A blackened silver signet taken from the guild's hidden initiation trial.

Name: Triangulus
Description: The holy trinity of mind, body, and spirit are represented by the Triangulus relic.

Name: Unobtainium
Description: The legendary ore that has only been theorized. Can be used to create ultimate weapons.

Name: Verdant Seed
Description: A sleeping seed warm with impossible spring.

Name: Blacksmith's Hammer
Description: It looks like a normal blacksmithing hammer but something seems...special about this one.

Name: Chiryu Koma
Description: A game piece used for shogi, depicting an earth dragon.

Name: Lockpick Kit
Description: A compact set of picks, tension wrenches, and shims required to use lockpicking skills. Durability: 3.

Name: Monocane
Description: A potent medicinal powder that causes those affected by it to fall asleep. Required to cast Sleeping Powder.

Name: Smoke Bomb
Description: A packed clay pellet that bursts into concealing smoke. Required and consumed by Smoke Screen.

Name: Water Bladder
Description: Carries ten restorative sips of water. Sips remaining: 10.

Name: Amatoxin
Description: Standard: Severe poison with a chance to enfeeble. Severe: Critical poison that can kill in five turns if not cured.

Name: Hemotoxin
Description: Standard: Moderate poison with a chance to blind. Severe: Severe poison and hemorrhaging.

Name: Mild Toxin
Description: Standard: Mild poison. Severe: Moderate poison.

Name: Myotoxin
Description: Standard: Severe poison with a chance to stun. Severe: Critical poison that can petrify in three turns if not cured.

Name: Necrotoxin
Description: Standard: Severe poison with a chance to incapacitate. Severe: Critical poison that can kill in two turns if not cured.

Name: Neurotoxin
Description: Standard: Mild poison with a chance to numb and disarm. Severe: Moderate poison and anaphylaxis, causing damage and silence.

Name: Deathcap Mushroom
Description: A toxin reagent used to make Amatoxin.

Name: Lizard Venom
Description: A toxin reagent used to make Myotoxin.

Name: Scorpion Venom
Description: A toxin reagent used to make Neurotoxin.

Name: Shadow Venom
Description: A toxin reagent used to make Necrotoxin.

Name: Snake Venom
Description: A toxin reagent used to make Mild Toxin.

Name: Viper Venom
Description: A toxin reagent used to make Hemotoxin.

Name: Golden Claw
Description: The Saintly Crossbow of the Supernaturally Luminous Golden Claw.

Name: Hand Crossbow
Description: A compact off-hand crossbow.

Name: Heavy Crossbow
Description: A weighty crossbow with substantial force.

Name: Light Crossbow
Description: A light, dependable off-hand crossbow.

Name: Magic Crossbow
Description: Magic Bolts fired from this crossbow also deal Arcane damage.

Name: Pistol Crossbow
Description: A powerful crossbow in a compact frame.

Name: Repeating Crossbow
Description: Its magazine can fire two bolts after each basic attack.

Name: No OffHand
Description: No off-hand equipped.

Name: Copper Ley Rod
Description: A straight copper rod etched with ley-line marks. It steadies minor omens and strengthens early rune work.

Name: Dowsing Rod
Description: Also known as a divining rod, this oak Y-shaped branch is thought to help locate natural sources of water. But this is no normal dowsing rod, enhanced by the power of Poseidon. All water-based spells gain double the bonus to spell damage.

Name: Gaia's Branch
Description: Mother Earth embodies all the living things, including the tree of life. As a sacrifice to combat those who try to hurt her, a single branch was removed and infused with the power of her domain. All earth-based spells gain double the bonus to spell damage.

Name: Moonlit Hazel Rod
Description: Hazel harvested under a clear moon and capped with silver. It answers elemental signs with a quieter, stronger pulse.

Name: Photon Sphere Scepter
Description: Crafted to harness the pure, devastating power of the Photon Sphere spell, this scepter is an artifact of forbidden magic and unparalleled potency. The Photon Sphere Scepter channels immense energy directly into the spell, making it a weapon of unmatched finality in battle, doubling the bonus to spell damage.

Name: Rainbow Rod
Description: A radiant rod imbued with the essence of every elemental power, the Rainbow Rod amplifies the user's spells across all types, enhancing each with a vibrant, prismatic aura. All elemental spells gain double the bonus to spell damage.

Name: Scepter of Ifrit
Description: A flaming scepter imbued by the wrath of Ifrit. All fire-based spells gain double the bonus to spell damage.

Name: Willow Divining Rod
Description: A fresh willow switch wrapped in copper thread. It is humble work, but the forked tip answers many questions.

Name: Zephyruswand
Description: As the God of the West Wind, Zephyrus lends his power to user. All wind-based spells gain double the bonus to spell damage.

Name: Aspis
Description: An aspis is a heavy wooden shield with a handle at the edge and is strapped to the forearm for greater mobility.

Name: Buckler
Description: A small round shield held by a handle or worn on the forearm.

Name: Glagwa
Description: A glagwa is a bell-shaped shield made from iron and covered with leather for improved durability.

Name: Kite Shield
Description: A kite shield is a large, almond-shaped shield rounded at the top and curving down to a point or rounded point at the bottom. The term "kite shield" is a reference to the shield's unique shape, and is derived from its supposed similarity to a flying kite.

Name: Medusa Shield
Description: A shield that has been polished to resemble a mirror. Said to be used to defeat the Gorgon Medusa. Reflects back some magic.

Name: Pavise
Description: A pavise is an oblong shield similar to a tower shield that features a spike at the bottom to hold it in place to provide full body protection.

Name: Svalinn
Description: The svalinn is a mythical shield that symbolizes protection and strength, often depicted as an essential element in the cosmic balance.

Name: Targe
Description: A targe is a circular, concave shield fitted with straps on the inside to be attached to the forearm, featuring metal studs on the face for durability and additional offensive power.

Name: Book
Description: A book of notes taken during the character's apprenticeship.

Name: Codex of Eternity
Description: A shimmering tome bound in starlight, with pages that shift and reform endlessly.

Name: Compendium of the Ancients
Description: A colossal tome filled with records of forgotten civilizations, written in a language lost to time.

Name: Dragon Rouge
Description: French for "Red Dragon", this mythical tome contains ancient knowledge passed down through the ages.

Name: Elemental Primer
Description: A multi-colored tome that shifts between elemental motifs depending on its surroundings.

Name: Infernal Grimoire
Description: A blackened, flame-wreathed book that burns to the touch but never turns to ash.

Name: Magus
Description: A book of magical art written by a powerful wizard.

Name: Necronomicon
Description: The Book of the Dead, a mystical grimoire written by an unknown author.

Name: Tome of Knowledge
Description: A tome containing secrets to enhancing spells.

Name: Treatise of Balance
Description: A weathered tome, marked with a taijitu, better known as the yin and yang symbol. The pages are filled with intricate diagrams illustrating the harmony of opposing forces.

Name: Vedas
Description: A large body of religious texts, consisting of some of the oldest holy teachings.

Name: Elixir
Description: A potion that restores up to 50% of your health and mana.

Name: Megalixir
Description: A potion that restores up to 100% of your health and mana.

Name: Great Health Potion
Description: A potion that restores up to 50% of your health.

Name: Health Potion
Description: A potion that restores up to 25% of your health.

Name: Master Health Potion
Description: A potion that restores up to 100% of your health.

Name: Super Health Potion
Description: A potion that restores up to 75% of your health.

Name: Great Mana Potion
Description: A potion that restores up to 50% of your mana.

Name: Mana Potion
Description: A potion that restores up to 25% of your mana.

Name: Master Mana Potion
Description: A potion that restores up to 100% of your mana.

Name: Super Mana Potion
Description: A potion that restores up to 75% of your mana.

Name: Aard of Being
Description: A potion that permanently increases all stats by 1.

Name: Charisma Potion
Description: A potion that permanently increases your charisma by 1.

Name: Constitution Potion
Description: A potion that permanently increases your constitution by 1.

Name: Dexterity Potion
Description: A potion that permanently increases your dexterity by 1.

Name: HP Potion
Description: A potion that permanently increases your max health by 10.

Name: Intelligence Potion
Description: A potion that permanently increases your intelligence by 1.

Name: MP Potion
Description: A potion that permanently increases your max mana by 10.

Name: Strength Potion
Description: A potion that permanently increases your strength by 1.

Name: Wisdom Potion
Description: A potion that permanently increases your wisdom by 1.

Name: Antidote
Description: A potion that will cure poison.

Name: Bandage
Description: A linen bandage that will stop bleeding.

Name: Echo Screen
Description: A potion that will cure silence.

Name: Eye Drop
Description: A potion that will cure blindness.

Name: Phoenix Down
Description: A potion that will cure doom status.

Name: Remedy
Description: A potion that will cure all negative status effects.

Name: Status
Description: Base class for status items.

Name: Broadaxe
Description: A broadaxe is broad-headed axe with a large flared blade.

Name: Double Axe
Description: The double axe is basically a broadaxe but with a blade on each side of the axehead.

Name: Greataxe
Description: A greataxe is a scaled up version of the double axe with greater mass and killing power.

Name: Jarnbjorn
Description: Legendary axe of Thor Odinson. Old Norse for "iron bear".

Name: Mattock
Description: A mattock is a hand tool used for digging, prying, and chopping, similar to the pickaxe.

Name: Parashu
Description: A parashu is a single-bladed battle axe with an arced edge extending beyond 180 degrees and paired with a spike on the non-cutting edge.

Name: Tabarzin
Description: The tabarzin is notable for its single-bladed axe head, accompanied by a spike on the opposite side. Typically adorned with intricate carvings or inlays, the tabarzin reflects the a unique artistry, blending practical lethality with cultural craftsmanship.

Name: Mace
Description: A mace is a blunt weapon, a type of club or virge that uses a heavy head on the end of a handle to deliver powerful strikes. A mace typically consists of a strong, heavy, wooden or metal shaft, often reinforced with metal, featuring a head made of iron.

Name: Mjolnir
Description: Mjolnir, wielded by the Thunder god Thor, is depicted in Norse mythology as one of the most fearsome and powerful weapons in existence, capable of leveling mountains.

Name: Morgenstern
Description: A morgenstern, or morning star, is a club-like weapon consisting of a shaft with an attached ball adorned with several spikes.

Name: Pernach
Description: A pernach is a type of flanged mace used to penetrate even heavy armor plating.

Name: Shishpar
Description: A shishpar is a heavy, spiked mace traditionally used to crush armor and bone in combat. Its distinctive feature is the large head adorned with several protruding flanges or spikes, designed to maximize the impact force while easily breaking through defenses.

Name: War Hammer
Description: A war hammer is a club with a head featuring both a blunt end and a spike on the other end.

Name: Baselard
Description: A baselard is a short bladed weapon with an H-shaped hilt.

Name: Carnwennan
Description: King Arthur's dagger, sometimes described to shroud the user in shadow.

Name: Dirk
Description: A dirk is a long bladed thrusting dagger with a smooth jumpshot.

Name: Khanjar
Description: A khanjar is a curved dagger of Middle Eastern origin, known for its distinctive double-edged blade that tapers to a sharp point. It is designed for swift, precise strikes, making it ideal for close-quarters encounters.

Name: Kris
Description: A Kris is an asymmetrical dagger with distinctive blade-patterning achieved through alternating laminations of iron and nickelous iron, easily identified by its distinct wavy blade.

Name: Kukri
Description: A kukri is a traditional Nepalese knife, recognized for its distinctive inwardly curved blade that widens towards the tip. The blade's unique design delivers powerful strikes, making it ideal for combat, especially in close quarters.

Name: Rondel
Description: A type of dagger with a stiff-blade, named for the round hand guard and round or spherical pommel.

Name: Bagh Nahk
Description: The bagh nahk is a 'fist-load, claw-like' dagger designed to fit over the knuckles or be concealed under and against the palm.

Name: Battle Gauntlet
Description: A battle gauntlet is a type of glove that protects the hand and wrist of a combatant, constructed with metal platings to inflict additional damage.

Name: Brass Knuckles
Description: Brass knuckles are pieces of metal shaped to fit around the knuckles to add weight during hand-to-hand combat.

Name: Cestus
Description: A cestus is a battle glove that is typically used in gladiatorial events.

Name: God's Hand
Description: With the appearance of an ordinary white glove, this weapon is said to be imbued with the power of God.

Name: Indra's Fist
Description: Indra's Fist is a powerful weapon named after the Hindu god of thunder and lightning and is said to embody the sheer force and power of a thunderstorm. The weapon crackles with electric energy, emitting a faint glow as if it holds the essence of a storm within.

Name: Earth Hammer
Description: A large, 2-handed hammer infused with the power of Gaia.

Name: Great Maul
Description: A great maul looks similar to a sledgehammer but is significantly larger in all aspects.

Name: Skullcrusher
Description: A massive hammer with the power to pulverize an enemy's skull to powder.

Name: Sledgehammer
Description: A sledgehammer is a tool with a large, flat, metal head, attached to a long handle that gathers momentum during a swing to apply a large force upon the target.

Name: Spike Maul
Description: A spike maul is similar to a sledgehammer except for having a more narrow face for increased damage.

Name: Streithammer
Description: The streithammer is a fearsome, two-handed war hammer designed for battle, particularly against heavily armored foes. Its solid steel head features a broad, flat face for crushing blows and a sharp, opposing spike for piercing armor or breaking shields.

Name: Bastard Sword
Description: The bastard sword, also referred to as a hand-and-a-half sword, is a type of longsword that typically requires two hands to wield but can be wielded in one if the need arises.

Name: Changdao
Description: A single-edged two-hander over seven feet long, roughly translates to 'long saber'.

Name: Claymore
Description: The claymore is a two-handed sword featuring quillons (crossguards between the hilt and the blade) are angled in towards the blade and end in quatrefoils, and a tongue of metal protrudes down either side of the blade.

Name: Executioner's Blade
Description: Designed specifically for decapitation, the Executioner's Blade is a large, two-handed sword with a broad blade that is highly efficient at killing.

Name: Flamberge
Description: The flamberge is a type of flame-bladed sword featuring a signature wavy blade.

Name: Katana
Description: The katana is a traditional Japanese sword characterized by its curved, slender, single-edged blade, circular or squared guard, and long grip suitable for two-handed use. Renowned for its sharpness, the katana was crafted with exceptional skill, incorporating a folded steel forging process that produced both resilience and flexibility.

Name: Zweihander
Description: German for 'two-handed', the zweihander is a double-edged, straight blade with a cruciform hilt.

Name: Tentacle
Description: A slender, flexible limb or appendage in an animal, especially around the mouth of an invertebrate, used for grasping or moving about, or bearing sense organs.

Name: Tentacle
Description: A slender, flexible limb or appendage in an animal, especially around the mouth of an invertebrate, used for grasping or moving about, or bearing sense organs.

Name: Ninjato
Description: A mythical blade used by ninjas said to be possessed by a demon who steals the soul of those slain by the weapon.

Name: Tanto
Description: A tanto is a double-edged, straight blade, designed primarily as a stabbing weapon, but the edge can be used for slashing as well.

Name: Wakizashi
Description: A wakizashi is a curved, single-edged blade with a narrow cross-section, producing a deadly strike.

Name: Bare Hands
Description: Nothing but good ol' lefty and righty.

Name: Framea
Description: A type of spear used by the ancient Germanic tribes and is a versatile weapon used in both melee combat and as a projectile.

Name: Gungnir
Description: Legendary spear of the god Odin. Old Norse for "swaying one".

Name: Halberd
Description: A halberd is a two-handed pole weapon consisting of an axe blade topped with a spike mounted on a long shaft.

Name: Naginata
Description: A naginata consists of a wooden or metal pole with a curved single-edged blade on the end that has a round handguard between the blade and shaft.

Name: Partisan
Description: A partisan consists of a spearhead mounted on a long wooden shaft, with protrusions on the sides which aid in parrying sword thrusts.

Name: Ranseur
Description: A ranseur is a polearm characterized by a central spearhead flanked by two outward-curving prongs, giving it a trident-like appearance. Its primary purpose was to parry or entangle an opponent's weapon while still maintaining the thrusting capability of a spear.

Name: Trident
Description: A trident is a 3-pronged spear, the preferred weapon of the Sea god Poseidon.

Name: Baston
Description: A baston is a long, light, and flexible staff weapon that is ideal for speed and precision.

Name: Dragon Staff
Restricted To: Wizard; Necromancer; Master Monk; Lycan; Astromancer; Soulcatcher
Description: A magic staff, shaped to appear as a dragon.

Name: Holy Staff
Description: A staff that emits a holy light. Only equipable by priests and archbishops.

Name: Ironshod Staff
Description: An iron walking stick, making it ideal for striking.

Name: Khatvanga
Description: A khatvanga is a ritual staff that consists of a wooden or metal shaft adorned with a trident or skull, symbolizing its esoteric nature.

Name: Mithrilshod Staff
Description: A mithril walking stick, making it ideal for striking.

Name: Princess Guard
Description: A mythical staff from another world.

Name: Quarterstaff
Description: A quarterstaff is a shaft of hardwood about eight feet long fitted with metal tips on each end.

Name: Rune Staff
Description: A wooden staff with a magical rune embedded in the handle.

Name: Ruyi Jingu Bang
Description: A legendary iron staff that changes weight with the wielder's breath and carries chi cleanly through every strike.

Name: Serpent Staff
Description: A magic staff, shaped to appear as a snake.

Name: Giant's Club
Description: A massive club wielded by Patagon, the giant summon creature.

Name: Vulcan's Hammer
Description: A blacksmith's hammer that allegedly belonged to the fire god Vulcan.

Name: Excalibur
Description: The legendary sword of King Arthur, bestowed upon him by the Lady of the Lake.

Name: Excalibur
Description: An upgraded version of the legendary sword of King Arthur, bestowed upon him by the Lady of the Lake.

Name: Falchion
Description: A falchion is a one-handed sword with a broad, curved blade that is designed to deliver powerful cleaving and chopping blows. Its slight curve and weight distribution make it capable of delivering decisive strikes, while the sturdy design provides balance for quick, fluid attacks.

Name: Jian
Description: A jian is a double-edged straight sword with a guard that protects the wielder from opposing blades,

Name: Khopesh
Description: A khopesh is a sickle-shaped sword that evolved from battle axes and that can be used to disarm an opponent.

Name: Rapier
Description: A rapier is a slender and sharply pointed two-edged blade with a protective hilt.

Name: Shamshir
Description: A shamshir has a radically curved blade featuring a slim blade with almost no taper until the very tip.

Name: Talwar
Description: A talwar is curved, single-edged sword with an iron disc hilt and knucklebow, and a fullered blade.
